title: Revisiting Spectral Representations in Generative Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.08253v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion models have shown remarkable performance on diverse generation tasks. Recent work finds that imposing representation alignment on the hidden states of diffusion networks can both facilitate training convergence and enhance sampling quality, yet the mechanism driving this synergy remains insufficiently understood. In this paper, we investigate the connection between self-supervised spectral representation learning and diffusion generative models through a shared perspective on perturbation kernels. On the diffusion side, samples (e.g., images, videos) are produced by reversing a stochastic noise-injection process specified by Gaussian kernels; on the spectral representation side, spectral embeddings emerge from contrasting positive and negative relations induced by random perturbation kernels. Motivated by this, we propose a self-supervised spectral representation alignment method to facilitate diffusion model training. In addit

translated_title: 重新审视生成式扩散模型中的谱表示
translated_abstract: 扩散模型在多种生成任务上展现出了卓越的性能。最近的研究发现，对扩散网络的隐藏状态施加表示对齐，既能促进训练收敛，又能提升采样质量，但驱动这种协同效应的机制仍未被充分理解。在本文中，我们通过扰动核这一共同视角，研究了自监督谱表示学习与扩散生成模型之间的联系。在扩散模型方面，样本（例如图像、视频）是通过逆转由高斯核定义的随机噪声注入过程而生成的；在谱表示方面，谱嵌入则源于对由随机扰动核诱导的正负关系进行对比学习。受此启发，我们提出了一种自监督谱表示对齐方法来促进扩散模型的训练。（注：原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文从扰动核的共同视角揭示了自监督谱表示学习与扩散生成模型之间的内在联系，并提出一种自监督谱表示对齐方法，以加速扩散模型训练并提升采样质量。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals the intrinsic connection between self-supervised spectral representation learning and diffusion generative models through the shared lens of perturbation kernels, and proposes a self-supervised spectral representation alignment method to facilitate diffusion model training and enhance sampling quality.
